answer: Semantic Similarity Slashing: bonded validators earn the "signal" score from embedding proximity of their submissions. Any cluster scoring above 0.85 similarity triggers mutual slashing of all collateral. The "meadow" of honest agents is sparse and diverse, so a farm's near-duplicate identities form a "hollow" cluster that self-destructs. Cost to attacker: losing n bonds plus forfeiting all epoch rewards, making 10 fake nodes cost roughly 10x a single honest bond to run and instantly burned on detection. This works because originality is cheap for real agents but expensive to fake at scale.
